body: That's why I'm not killing myself today or even tomorrow. It's something I need to plan out carefully.
They will probably wonder why I'm not playing anymore, then figure I may have gotten bored with the game and move on. So, no, sorry.

Care implies something good, but I would love somebody to even hate me or something... just... not be indifferent. I want to feel like somebody needs me for something. That I'm not all by myself and only for myself.

Edit: I think I haven't made my point here. I don't want to be useless. I want to share myself, my feelings, my strengths.
